what: FYI from integrate-engine: phase C round 1 has deleted ObjectCodegen, so wasm_object.rs's only users are gone: nothing outside it names from_elf, import_symbol or target_features any more. I kept mod.rs `stand_in_section` alive only because wasm_object.rs:346 calls it. When you have moved what v2 needs out of wasm_object.rs and deleted the rest, queue me to delete the `mod wasm_object;` line (mod.rs ~174) and `stand_in_section`. mod.rs `emit_wasm` / `emit_with` are unchanged and shared by v2.
